title: Tech Lead, Software Development Engineering
jobDescription: Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. Job Title. Tech Lead, Software Development Engineering. What does a successful Senior JAVA Engineer do at Fiserv? At Fiserv we are reimagining payment technology through an AI-first transformation. As a Senior Java Engineer you will pair deep engineering expertise with AI-assisted delivery to build the next generation of event-driven, cloud-native payment services. You will architect and ship resilient platforms, champion responsible AI adoption, and help teams move faster while staying compliant and secure. What you will do. Design, build, and ship high-quality microservices and event-driven capabilities that power modern experiences. Partner with architecture, product, data science, and AI platform teams to embed machine learning and AI-assisted workflows in customer and operational journeys. Lead the decomposition and modernisation of legacy components, applying domain-driven design, strangler patterns, and AI-accelerated refactoring techniques. Curate, instrument, and document systems so AI copilots and autonomous runbooks can observe, learn, and act safely (telemetry, feature flags, guardrails). Drive engineering excellence through thoughtful design reviews, automated testing, chaos/resilience practices, and codified reliability standards. Improve developer experience with automated pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, and AI-enabled tooling that shorten feedback loops. Coach and mentor engineers on AI-first ways of working: prompt literacy, pair-programming with copilots, responsible-use guidelines, and experimentation discipline. Balance transformation ambition with delivery commitments by making pragmatic, data-informed engineering trade-offs and communicating risks early. Develop scalable applications using Java / Python / React / Cloud, enhanced with AI‑assisted development. Integrate ML/AI APIs, vector stores, embeddings, or automation services into applications. Use AI tools to generate unit tests, improve code quality, refactor legacy components. Build or consume AI microservices following secure design patterns. What you need to have. 8–12+ years of total hands-on software engineering experience delivering software in complex, distributed, highly regulated environments. Expert-level Java skills plus fluency with modern frameworks, testing libraries, and build tooling. Hands-on experience with AWS (or comparable cloud) and building cloud-native, containerised services on Kubernetes. Working knowledge of event-driven architectures and streaming platforms such as Kafka; able to model, test, and operate event flows at scale. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability stacks, and Site Reliability/Dev Ops practices. Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, internal copilots) or building ML/LLM-enabled services; comfort applying AI responsibly. Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and navigate. Strong programming fundamentals (Java, etc.). Experience with AI APIs (Open AI, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock) is a plus. What would be great to have. Experience designing or consuming LLM‑powered features, conversational APIs, or AI‑driven automation workflows. Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and AI evaluation techniques. Exposure to payments, transaction processing, or real‑time financial systems. Knowledge of multiple cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP). Passion for continuous learning, modern engineering practices, and applying AI responsibly to real‑world problems. Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please. Apply using your legal name. Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion. Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Note to agencies. Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. Warning about fake job posts. Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

Validating access requests and ensuring accurate gathering and distribution of performance data to clients. Validate team metrics accurately reflect available-to-work, output goals, and output achievements, and are shared with the team daily to drive excellence. Lead workflow distribution and inventory management to ensure network timeframes and service levels are consistently met; resolve complex client concerns and disputes. Evaluate current workflows across teams to identify bottlenecks, redundancies, and areas for improvement. Analyze and evaluate production processes to optimize efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness. Gather and interpret data to identify improvement opportunities. Implement strategies to enhance productivity and streamline processes. Collaborating with various departments to align with client service level agreements. Job Title. Hardware Operations & Client Support Specialist. About your role. Fiserv delivers technology solutions that help financial institutions and businesses move money and manage commerce with speed and confidence. Within Hardware Services, this role supports day-to-day hardware operations through order management, case resolution, and logistics coordination across the full service lifecycle. You will help ensure accurate processing, timely fulfillment, and effective resolution of client and operational issues while partnering across teams to support service quality and SLA performance. What you’ll do. Manage the end-to-end hardware order lifecycle, including order entry, order updates, cancellations, shipment tracking, replacements, repairs, and returns. Create, monitor, and resolve cases in Salesforce and shared support channels, ensuring accurate documentation, proper routing, and timely closure aligned to SLA expectations. Investigate and resolve order, shipping, inventory, and device-related issues, including delayed shipments, incorrect deliveries, lost packages, and equipment discrepancies. Coordinate shipping and logistics activities with carriers and warehouse teams, including reroutes, delivery corrections, claims, and tracking updates. Provide operational support for hardware devices and transaction-related issues, escalating to specialized teams when required. Partner with Deployment, Maintenance, IT, Billing, and Logistics teams to drive issue resolution, clarify ownership, and maintain alignment on service delivery. Support inventory lifecycle activities, including tracking, reconciliation, return validation, and replacement equipment availability. Identify and escalate system defects, process gaps, and operational risks to support resolution and continuous improvement. Manage daily queues, shared inboxes, and operational trackers to prioritize work and maintain visibility into open items. Participate in SLA reporting, operational reviews, and performance tracking to support compliance and process improvement. Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary. Job Title. Quality Assurance, Reporting & Operations Analyst. Role Overview . The Quality Assurance, Reporting & Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting collections operations through quality assurance, business analytics, reporting, compliance oversight, and operational administration. This role monitors customer interactions and issue resolution processes, provides coaching and performance feedback, develops and automates reports and dashboards, analyzes business trends, and delivers actionable insights to leadership. The position also supports agency placements, payment processing, bankruptcy administration, vendor management, account validations, UCC filings, workflow distribution, and other operational functions. Working closely with operations leadership, reporting teams, business partners, third-party vendors, and executive stakeholders, this individual serves as a key resource for driving process improvements, ensuring compliance, improving operational efficiency, and supporting strategic business decisions through data-driven analysis. What will you do . Monitor and evaluate collection calls, customer interactions, and issue resolution activities to ensure compliance and quality standards. Provide coaching, feedback, and recommendations to improve agent performance and customer experience. Create, maintain, and automate operational reports, dashboards, KPI scorecards, forecasting models, and executive reporting. Analyze business performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and process improvement initiatives. Support financial and operational decision-making through detailed reporting and analytics. Manage third-party vendor invoicing, agency placements, and account submissions. Perform account validations, transaction reviews, bankruptcy processing, funding diversion management, and UCC filing coordination. Process customer payments and manage banking-related communications and payment exceptions. Distribute operational worklists, monitor workflow assignments, and maintain administrative records. Generate and distribute buyback, suspense, exception, and performance reports. Support complaint resolution, special projects, operational initiatives, and business transformation efforts. Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. Job Title. Analytics Executive
- Business Transformation. What does a great Analytics Executive
- Business Transformation do? As an Analytics Executive
- Business Transformation, you will turn complex data into insights that influence high-value enterprise decisions across priority business areas. Work on Fiserv’s biggest priorities alongside its senior-most leaders. Own high-impact initiatives end to end, learn from exceptional peers, and help shape the future of the business. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, business performance, commercial evaluation, and AI-enabled decision support. You will analyze complex business questions, quantify opportunities, build scenarios, and develop insight-led recommendations for senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capability with commercial mindset, structured problem-solving, visualization skills, and the ability to translate data into clear executive storytelling. What You'll Do. Opportunity Sizing & Business Insights. Quantify high-value opportunity pools across priority transformation areas and business themes. Analyze large and complex datasets to identify business drivers, risks, gaps, trends, and improvement opportunities. Conduct commercial evaluations, customer analysis, product analysis, profitability reviews, and performance diagnostics. Deep-Dive Analytics & Scenario Modelling. Analyze complex business questions beyond standard reporting and develop insight-led recommendations. Build scenario models to evaluate options, trade-offs, sensitivities, and business impact. Develop forecasting models, analytical frameworks, and performance views to support strategic decisions. Visualization, Storytelling & AI Enablement. Create clear dashboards, visualizations, and executive-ready analysis packs for leadership discussions. Leverage AI and advanced analytics tools to scale insights, automate analysis, and improve decision quality. Translate analytical findings into practical actions, business narratives, and measurable outcomes. What you will need to have. 4-6 years of experience in analytics, data science, consulting, finance, business intelligence, or related functions. Strong SQL, Python, visualization, modelling, and quantitative analysis skills. Strong analytical storytelling with the ability to simplify complex datasets into clear business recommendations. Commercial mindset with experience evaluating performance, opportunity pools, scenarios, and business impact. Advanced Microsoft Excel and Power Point skills with experience preparing executive-level analysis. People management and team handling experience, including guiding junior analysts, managing work allocation, and reviewing analytical outputs. Ability to coordinate small analytics workstreams, mentor team members, and drive delivery against defined timelines. Experience That Would Be Great to Have. Experience in pricing, voice of customer, attrition analytics, demand generation, sales effectiveness, or commercial analytics. Experience in fintech, payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or technology organizations. Exposure to BI and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Alteryx, Python, R, or similar technologies. Experience supporting AI-enabled analytics, process automation, or digital modernization initiatives. Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please. Apply using your legal name. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
